people: computer_whisperer (the user himself as the opponent; lobby skill 6.02, Armada, handicap +100%, so income x2), hosting; spectators [gecko]u6bkep (19.24) and [gecko]Covariance (16.84), neither typed; a ranked SPADS lobby game
our_side: one seat (team 1, side Random, played Cortex: corcom at H6 in the east box); the player was Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) at effort medium, the side's commander agent Opus 5.5 at effort high (25 turns), the hands Jev 1.14.0 at hands effort normal; realtime; no bonus on our side
build: f6e9a07 (committed 2026-10-18 18:53; banner at f=69: 'Within Reason f6e9a07 | player (claude-opus-5-5, effort medium, 2.1.303 (Claude Code)) | hands: Jev jev-1.14.0')
summary: A 1v1 on Cape Violet against the user himself at +100% income. We played Cortex in the east and only ever built on land: 3 extractors until 3:00, then 16-19 from 8:00 to the end on 21 distinct spots, while none of the 14 under-water spots east of the middle was ever built (our commander could have built them from 0:00). Our early Incisors reached C5 by 6:38, then went into his Centurions a few at a time at D4-D5 (7:06-7:40), and after that our mass never stood in his half again. His bot wave broke on our turrets and Pounders at F6 (8:33-9:48, 6,458 of his for 2,510 of ours) and we built tier 2 at 9:43, but from 11:59 he took the sea, raised our wrecks with resurrection bots, and went through Fatboys (15:13), a fleet that broke our 16:50 push on the E4 shore, and Titans (23:55). We broke his Fatboy waves at G6 (19-23 min) but lost 11k for 2.4k charging two Titans at F6 (26:47-27:46) and about 27 bombers to their anti-air; an Epoch (29:56) and two nuclear missiles (31:02 and 32:20, no anti-nuke ever finished) ended it, and his base was never seen.

root.what: The player put off the under-water spots and never came back to them. Neither it nor the commander agent ordered a sea extractor, Muskrat, hover constructor or shipyard. Our count stopped at the land ceiling, though 14 spots no bot of ours could walk to lay east of the middle, the nearest (spot_57, G7) 1,175 from home and in reach of the amphibious commander from the first minute.
root.evidence: 0:10 player: 'A Muskrat for the under-water spots comes later.' Record: 39 extractor completions (26 cormex, 13 cormoho) on 21 spots, none under water; no cormuskrat, corch or corsy made. The user after the game: 'it looks like the player never tried to expand into the water slots'.

their_play: The person (Armada bots, +100% income, lobby skill 6) guarded the B3 passage with a Guard turret and four Centurions by 5:00. His Pawn/Rocketeer/Centurion wave of about 3-5k left at 7:45 and broke on our turrets at F6 by 9:48; Pawn waves came again at 12:00-13:00. He had a shipyard by about 11:59: a construction ship on spot_27 (G3, our half), a Dolphin at our H2 extractors at 12:02, Corsairs from 12:41. From 12:19 his resurrection bots raised our wrecks at F5-F6. An advanced bot lab stood by about 12:30 (Zeus, Welders). Fatboys came from 15:13: six to nine of them with Corsairs, Dolphins and Ellysaws at E4 (17:57-18:47) and at G6 (20:39-23:16). Then a gantry: a Titan with eleven Lazarus at C4 by 23:55, two Titans at F6 by 27:00, an Epoch at F3 by 29:56, and a nuclear silo at A2 whose missiles landed at 31:02 and 32:20. He fought almost entirely in our half: his seen losses were 46,049 there and 14,300 at our base, against 370 in his own half. His base, factories and commander were never seen by us.

defects.defect: The water words, before the fix: the score line and the 'no growth' wake counted only the spots we can walk to, and no report ever named a water spot. The words 'under water' were computed into place descriptions that neither the player nor Jev was shown. The loss rests partly on this defect, since fixed.

bears_on.note: Our extractor count was flat at 16-19 from 8:00 to the end, on 21 distinct land spots, with 14 water spots east of the middle never built. The user's post-game reading names expansion as the fault.
The visible killers were Titans, the Epoch and two missiles, but the person's reading puts the loss on extractors (the water slots) twenty minutes earlier.
7:06-7:40: groups B, F and E reached four Centurions one at a time at D4-D5 (#1: 600 lost for 0).
After his wave broke at 9:48, and through the minutes at 3.6x (12:00-13:00) and 2.2-14.6x (17:00-19:00), the body stayed at F6-G6. Those ratios are against the army we saw, which is a floor.
His resurrection bots raised our wrecks at F5-F6 from 12:19 while 2.9-5.5k lay unreclaimed until 15:20. Once we did reclaim (22:50-24:00), our income reached 230-314.
We made 164 Brutes beside our Banishers and Tigers, and at 24:20 the commander agent chose to mass Brutes against the Titan. They died in bulk: 30 in #19, 44 in #24 to the missile.
Our Rascals crossed at 3:03 and twelve Incisors at 4:43-6:08, and one extractor of his at C3 died by 4:01. The Incisors were then fed into Centurions. Crossing early is not the same as paying.
The reader's reading: the map's tidal strength is 20 (record header), yet no tidal generator was built, while energy stalled in minutes 12-14 (e0% 7.3).

lens.caveats: There is no truth file, so all of his numbers are sightings (floors) and minutes.py's ratios compare our army with the army we saw. pro_baseline.py was not run (it covers Comet only; no Cape Violet pool). commander_turns.py and wake_read.py need the 00 directory: on the match directory commander_turns printed nothing. The record's unit_defs 'id' is 1-based, so killers must be named by list index (by id the Titan reads as armawac). There is no ledger row for this game. Where I differ from the existing review: (a) its '39 extractors on land' counts completions (26 cormex + 13 cormoho) on 21 distinct spots; (b) its spot_12 F2 is unwalkable, not a land spot left untaken; (c) it gives 13 water spots in our half, while I count 14 unwalkable spots east of x=5120. I keep its 0:10 root on the user's post-game words; minutes.py alone gives 7:00.

open_questions: Would the 14 east-side water spots (about +13 extractors by 10:00) have held the economy against +100% income? We have no truth file for his extractors; the commander agent's predicts ranged from 13 to 22.
At 27:46-28:20, did the Titans' anti-air fire while our ground units were in their reach, or only after the body pulled back? The scenes for #19-#22 would say.
Does a nuclear strike reach the player's report as a missile? The wake called it shelling by 'armsilo (a turret)', and the commander agent misattributed the 31:02 losses.
The brief's Cape Violet plan named Armada's Beaver (armbeaver) while we drew Cortex. The player translated it to a Muskrat, but the sheet's plan is tied to one faction.
